Name: (CP) Robin Sells Hardwood
Author: TeacupCreations
Description:
Ever find yourself with [i]so muc[/i]h money but [i]no[/i] hardwood? Don't want to wait for trees to grow?
This mod allows you to buy hardwood at Robin's store with configurable prices and stock limits.

I wanted to make this mod a bit more immersive and balanced so hardwood is not available from the beginning by default. It is instead unlocked after reaching Ginger Island and viewing a special event. After rceieving a letter in the mail, hardwood will be available to buy from Robin's store. Due to its rarity, the wood is quite pricey and has a limited stock.

[b]Configurable Options
[/b]The mod is fully configurable with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] so you can:
[list]
[*][b]Make hardwood available from day 1[/b]. This skips the custom event entirely and simply adds hardwood to the shop
[*][b]Set the price of hardwood[/b]. By default, this is set to 500 but you can make it as cheap (or expensive) as you want
[*][b]Set the amount of stock available[/b]. By Default this is set to 50 a day but you can change this to whatever number you want, or remove the limit entirely.
[/list]
[b]Detailed information on unlock event
[/b]You should be able to trigger the event naturally after unlocking ginger island but if you are having problems, the specific requirements for each event are below.
[spoiler]Part 1:
Location: Ginger Island North
Day: Not a festival, not Tuesday
Time: 8:00-18:00
Player has found 5 golden walnuts

Part 2:
Location: Farm
Day: Not Tuesday
At least one day after player has seen part 1
[/spoiler]

[b]Limitations & Known Issues
[/b]
[list]
[*]With great power comes great respisbilbilites, Mod may break if you add anything other than numbers into the price or stock limit config. I haven't figured out how to turn these into sliders.
[*]The letter that tells you that hardwood is available in the store is luck based, each day after seeing the unlock event, there is a 30% chance that the mail will appear in your mail box.
[/list]
